Gnosis VPN for Windows (prototype, for testing only)

Gnosis VPN for Windows is an experimental prototype. It is not a finished or supported product, and it has not been security-audited.

- It may expose your traffic. There is no kill switch: if the tunnel fails, traffic goes out directly, and a fault in this prototype can send traffic outside the tunnel at any time.
- It spends real funds on Gnosis Chain. Only fund it with amounts you can afford to lose.
- It comes without any warranty (GNU General Public License v3.0).

Do not rely on it to protect your identity or your data.


1. Extract this zip into your own Downloads folder (right-click > Extract All); not under C:\ directly.
2. Double-click Install.cmd and allow the admin prompt. If SmartScreen appears: More info > Run anyway.
3. The app starts by itself; later use Start menu > Gnosis VPN.

Uninstall.cmd removes it again (the node identity in C:\ProgramData\GnosisVPN is kept).
